event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
One member of the original panel composition was replaced, Jean-Bernard Luther was replaced by Heiko Thölmann as required by RRS 63.7(c)(2).
ESP 221420 did not come to the hearing, the hearing proceeded in accordance with RRS 63.1(b).
facts: The decision on the original case nr. 35 was given on 15th August at 20:30.
The International Jury considered if it may have made a significant error.
There was no evidence presented to support this assumption.
conclusions: The protest committee did not make a significant error in the
. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(2) for reopening the hearing are not met.
decision: Hearing Nr. 35 will not be reopened.
